title: Scenario A: Silent Window & Comm-Loss Protocol
description: Sub-unit operating in mountainous terrain experiences sudden electronic spectrum occlusion, resulting in feed dropout and latency spikes during a planned logistics corridor escort.
learning_objectives: Execute sub-unit contingency protocol during total sensor silence
Identify stale telemetry without panicking into uncoordinated maneuvers
Re-establish cross-role synchronization upon delayed channel recovery

roles.title: Convoy Sub-Unit Commander
roles.description: Authorized to hold, advance, or redirect convoy route.

roles.title: Route Clearance & Operations Lead
roles.description: Monitors waypoint checkpoints and vehicle interval spacing.

roles.title: Signals & Spectrum Monitoring Specialist
roles.description: Analyzes RF signal-to-noise ratio and satellite uplink integrity.

payload.message: Overhead visual confirms Sector 2 pass accessible.

decision_points.prompt: SATCOM telemetry is down and UAV feed is showing 55s latency. Convoy approaches fork at Kilometer 12. Proceed blindly into defile, halt convoy into defensive box, or take unverified eastern ridge trail?

options.label: Halt Convoy into Defensive Box
options.description: Establish perimeter defense, initiate local VHF relay search, and await channel restoration.

options.label: Continue Primary Route on Dead Reckoning
options.description: Maintain tactical speed despite zero live telemetry to meet schedule window.

options.label: Divert Entire Unit to Unreconnoitered Ridge Trail
options.description: Avoid defile completely without ground confirmation of vehicle weight capacity.

outcome_rules.narrative: Sub-unit halted safely outside the rockfall choke point. When SATCOM restored at T=160, obstacle was identified and safely bypassed with zero vehicle damage.
outcome_rules.ground_truth_fact: Kilometer 14 was impassable due to rockfall; pushing through would have trapped the convoy in a kill-zone choke point.

outcome_rules.narrative: Lead vehicles collided with rockfall at Kilometer 14 due to stale UAV feed. Sub-unit became immobilized for 4 hours.
outcome_rules.ground_truth_fact: Rockfall occurred at T=35; stale feed concealed the blockage.
